gastritis_gerd.label: Gastritis / GERD

regimens.label: PPI monotherapy
regimens.note: First-line for erosive esophagitis and moderate-to-severe GERD

regimens.label: H2RA monotherapy
regimens.note: Second-line or step-down for mild-to-moderate GERD

regimens.label: Alginate monotherapy
regimens.note: For mild/reflux-predominant symptoms; works as physical barrier

regimens.label: Antacid on-demand
regimens.note: Symptom relief only — no mucosal healing

regimens.label: Sucralfate monotherapy
regimens.note: Topical barrier; useful in mild disease or pregnancy (non-systemic)

regimens.label: PPI + Alginate
regimens.incremental_benefit: Faster symptom relief; improves regurgitation control by 25-30% over PPI alone
regimens.safety_delta: No added systemic risk — alginate is non-systemic
regimens.note: Recommended for regurgitation-dominant GERD or incomplete PPI response

regimens.label: PPI + H2RA (nocturnal)
regimens.incremental_benefit: Reduces nocturnal acid breakthrough (NAB); ~15% improvement in nighttime symptoms
regimens.safety_delta: Low added risk; H2RA tolerance develops at ~14 days, limiting long-term use
regimens.note: Reserve for confirmed nocturnal acid breakthrough; H2RA tolerance limits chronic use

regimens.label: PPI + Antacid (on-demand)
regimens.incremental_benefit: Rapid on-demand relief for breakthrough symptoms between PPI doses
regimens.safety_delta: Minimal; avoid calcium carbonate CKD accumulation; not for daily use
regimens.note: On-demand rescue for breakthrough symptoms only — not routine combination

regimens.label: H2RA + Antacid (mild)
regimens.incremental_benefit: Combined acid suppression + rapid neutralization for mild intermittent symptoms
regimens.note: For mild intermittent symptoms without need for daily PPI

regimens.label: PPI + Sucralfate
regimens.incremental_benefit: Modest improvement in healing for severe erosive esophagitis
regimens.safety_delta: QID dosing burden; aluminum accumulation in CKD (contraindicated in CrCl <30)
regimens.note: Reserve for severe erosive disease not responding to PPI alone

mono_comparison_notes: PPI is first-line — best healing rates (92% at 8 wk), superior acid suppression
H2RA is second-line — 70% healing, tolerates develop at ~14d
Alginate is non-inferior to H2RA for reflux symptoms but does not heal esophagitis
Antacids provide symptom relief only; no healing effect
Sucralfate has niche role (pregnancy, mild disease, topical barrier)
